description: Restraint test. The agent should run one search, see no results, and stop — no shell fallbacks, no hallucinated references, no fabricated line numbers. Cheap and binary; the natural template for any new negative-path eval.
prompt: Find all references to class `zcl_does_not_exist_xyz_42` in the system.
notes: Loose needles are appropriate here because the answer space is the *category* of correct response, not a specific identifier. antiNeedles catch fabrication: any phrasing that would only appear if the agent invented references is failed. `forbiddenCapabilities: ["referenceSearch"]` enforces the restraint at the runner level — the agent should reason from the search miss, not call reference-search on a non-existent target.
